title: Adaptive Mixtures of Local Experts
authors: R. Jacobs, M. Jordan, S. Nowlan, G. Hinton
before: One network had to learn every part of a task with the same parameters.
problem: Different regions of a problem want different specialists, and one dense model spends all its capacity on all of it.
breakthrough: Several expert subnetworks plus a gating network that decides which expert handles which input.
why: This is the ancestor of every sparse mixture-of-experts model, including Mixtral, DeepSeek and Llama 4.
next: Dormant for 25 years until Shazeer scaled it in 2017.
inherits: Conditional computation: activate a fraction of the parameters per token.
